scope: Repair a second false directional veto caused by treating fused visits as one coherent first-return observation. Retain all acceptance thresholds and interfaces.

identity.kind: Independent UNVERIFIED development builds; no installation, release tag or navigation frozen library replaced.

execution.compiler_launcher: ccache in final Humble and Noetic configurations
execution.performance_scope: Serial full-input A/B replays. Process CPU includes all workers; CPU/input-duration includes both search and tracking and is not active-search occupancy. First-lock wall time excludes map loading.
execution.cache_scope: Identical frozen explicit legacy Atlas in both variants; loading and RSS are not current default-cache startup measurements.

saved_map_reference.provenance: Map-derived observations, evaluated at saved-map poses, not independent hardware ground truth. These poses are only used in offline diagnostics, never supplied to relocalization.
saved_map_reference.nearest_point_check: Every query return had a map neighbor within 0.1 m; lack of map surface coverage did not explain this witness failure.
saved_map_reference.runtime_scope: This snippet is rejected earlier by ambiguity/margin checks. The oracle demonstrates a possible final-witness veto, not a newly successful full relocalization.

alternatives_rejected: Replacing the fused map with a single stored cloud loses support on three projected views whose fused-map witnesses pass.
A temporal submap union still fails the reproduced saved-map reference.
Changing angular resolution or bin origin can change the score but does not repair the mixed-observation model.

implementation.trigger: Only a finite insufficient fused-map witness reaches the coherent-reference recheck. Unavailable or unobservable geometry keeps its existing rejection.
implementation.references: At most the candidate seed and support keyframes; duplicate IDs evaluated once. Existing clouds and optimized poses are used.
implementation.acceptance: One complete observation must independently exceed 0.5 in all planar directions. No per-direction maximum across views and no farther-background substitution within a view.
implementation.compute: Reuse the query normal fit. No additional ICP, new spatial index, worker pool or persistent cache. directional_check_ms includes the recheck. Successful reference ID and both support scores are logged.

validation.humble_ctest: 69/69; five ROS checks run with the sourced runtime, localhost-only DDS and workspace log directory.
validation.noetic_ctest: 67/67 in the existing rc4 validation image.

new_end_to_end_regression.name: DirectionalReference.StoredObservationMustIndependentlySupportTheCandidate
new_end_to_end_regression.baseline: Correct candidate rejected by fused support about 0.122; negative foreground case also rejected.
new_end_to_end_regression.candidate: Correct candidate locks with independent reference support 1.0 and position error below 0.1 m. When every stored view contains the foreground, support remains about 0.122 and no pose locks.
new_end_to_end_regression.ablation: Same new test executable against the frozen pre-change core fails only the clean-reference expectation; candidate core passes both cases.
new_end_to_end_regression.profile: Existing synthetic relocation fixture with a three-frame window and explicit Atlas. Free-space is disabled only in this focused regression; frozen 14-point and route comparisons use the unchanged product configuration.

multilevel_map_derived_short_replays.provenance: Map-projected and archived-keyframe-derived clouds with fixed dropout/noise; not raw independent sensor recordings.
multilevel_map_derived_short_replays.incorrect_candidate: The previously identified approximately 12 m wrong candidate remains unpublished.
multilevel_map_derived_short_replays.remaining: Three other snippets remain behind ambiguity/margin checks. They were not all directional-support rejections.

interpretation: This stage repairs a reproduced representation error and preserves the frozen accuracy/reliability baseline. First-lock latency, total CPU and RSS are effectively unchanged on that baseline; this is not a compute-acceleration claim.
remaining: No universal probabilistic or cross-scene calibration of 0.5 is claimed. Limited coverage and genuinely ambiguous geometry can still remain searching.
Independent raw hardware inputs are still needed to qualify field behavior. Map-derived saved-pose diagnostics cannot establish hardware accuracy.
